caption: The drawing depicts a men's formal suit consisting of a long black coat, a cream-colored waistcoat, and black knee-breeches. The coat is adorned with elaborate floral embroidery featuring green leaves and white flowers with yellow centers, running along the front edges, collar, cuffs, and pocket flaps. The waistcoat is cream with a delicate floral pattern in green and pink, and it is fastened with small buttons. The shirt beneath the waistcoat has a ruffled white front. The knee-breeches match the coat in color and have buttons at the knee and a decorative embroidered band at the hem. There is a secondary, simpler line drawing of the back view of the entire ensemble, showing the same long coat with floral embroidery in a more schematic style without any color. The drawing is rendered primarily in black, cream, green, white, pink, and yellow on a plain beige background.
title: Man's Court Costume
